notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.
